title: Evaluate logistic labels and probability scores
description: You inspect test metrics, an ROC curve, and a confusion matrix.

steps.description: You obtain test labels and class-1 probabilities from pipe. Accuracy uses predicted labels, and F1 explicitly treats label 1 as positive.

steps.question: Does ROC AUC receive predicted labels or probability scores?
steps.answer: It receives y_test_proba, the class-1 probability scores. These support comparisons across thresholds.

steps.description: You print accuracy 0.877, F1 0.903, and ROC AUC 0.953 in the recording. The plot compares the ROC curve with the two labeled reference curves.
You compute the confusion matrix from test labels and predicted labels. Its display prints integer cell counts.
